title: Robustness and independent dataset evaluation of 2D-FFT feature engineering for ATR-FTIR COVID-19 severity classification
description: MATLAB R2024b code and derived outputs for a patient-level robustness evaluation of 2D-FFT feature engineering in ATR-FTIR COVID-19 severity classification. The archive includes held-out predictions, paired-bootstrap contrasts, matched-PC and nonredundant-coefficient sensitivity analyses, conventional-classifier benchmarks, 50-repeat development validation, 25-seed MLP variability, DOI verification, and vector plus 600-dpi figures. Source spectra are referenced but not redistributed.
